text:
This is Johnny Castaway.
Stranded on a tiny island
with one palm tree.
He wears white shorts and a hat.

It is Christmas.
A small tree with red bulbs
and a golden star.

It is Halloween.
A carved jack-o-lantern
sits on the island.

It is New Years.
A banner reads Happy New Year
on the palm tree.

It is St Patrick's Day.
Four-leaf clovers grow
on the island.

It is night.
The island is bathed
in moonlight.

It is day.
The sun shines brightly.
It is a regular day.

It is high tide.
Waves lap at the island.

It is low tide.
Waves lap at the island.
The scene fades to black.

Johnny walks around
the island.

Johnny dives off the palm tree.
A perfect flip into the ocean.
Crabs and seagull hold up
low scorecards.

Johnny dives off the palm tree.
It turns into a belly-flop.
Crabs and seagull hold up
low scorecards.

Johnny reads under the tree.
A seagull lands on his head.
He swings a club but misses
and hits himself.

Johnny bathes in the ocean.
A seagull steals his clothes
for its nest.
Johnny shivers angrily.

Johnny reads under the tree.
A seagull swoops down
and steals his book.

Johnny climbs the palm tree.
He looks around, then dives.
He walks back and looks around.

Johnny fans himself in heat.
He does a rain dance in a mask.
A cloud appears but no rain.
Lightning strikes him to ash.

Johnny reads under the tree.
He falls asleep.
A coconut bonks his head.
He wakes and keeps reading.

Johnny reads under the tree.
He scratches his head confused.
The book was upside down.
He flips it and reads on.

Johnny bathes in the ocean.
He scrubs, smells the brush
in disgust, grabs his clothes
and walks behind the tree.

Johnny wears a mask and skirt.
A yacht couple takes photos.
His grass skirt falls open.
The yacht sails away.

Johnny builds a sand castle.
It crumbles.
He stomps it in frustration.

Johnny sleeps under the tree.
Lilliputians row ashore
and tie him down.
A seagull nests on him.

Johnny sleeps under the tree.
Zs float as he snores.
He walks to the island edge.

Johnny builds a sand castle.
Lilliputians claim it as
their fortress.
Tiny planes attack Johnny.

Johnny tries to build a fire.
He rubs sticks together.
It finally lights!
He warms his hands, it dies.

Johnny relaxes by a fire.
He roasts an old boot.
He eats the boot whole.

Johnny sleeps under the tree.
Lilliputians row ashore
and tie him down.
He goes back to sleep.

Johnny goes fishing.
He catches a starfish.
He throws it back.

Johnny goes fishing.
He catches a boot.
He keeps the boot.

Johnny goes fishing.
He catches five green fish.
Then an angry octopus.
The octopus chokes him.

Johnny goes fishing.
He catches a shark.
The shark drags him around
the ocean like a jet-ski.

Johnny goes fishing.
A shark eats him.
The shark spits him back out.

Johnny goes fishing.
He catches a big green fish.
It spits water in his face.

Johnny goes fishing.
He catches a crab.
It snaps his nose.

Johnny goes fishing.
He catches a boot.
He keeps the boot.

A clock spins wildly.
Sunset silhouette. A plane.
Johnny parachutes down.
The End.

A bottle washes ashore.
Johnny writes an S.O.S.
He corks the bottle
and throws it out to sea.

Johnny writes a message.
He imagines a clock at 3pm.
He throws the bottle out
to prepare for his date.

A bottle washes ashore.
Johnny picks it up excitedly.
Sadly, it is his own S.O.S.
He throws it back out.

Johnny writes an S.O.S.
He corks the bottle
and throws it out to sea.

A clock spins wildly.
Johnny types at an office PC.
He dreams of the island
and the mermaid. He looks sad.

Johnny sets up a fancy dinner.
A mermaid appears.
They eat, toast champagne,
and dance. She swims away.

A mermaid swims up.
She gives Johnny a necklace.
He gives her a life preserver.
He proposes a date.

Johnny fishes at the edge.
A mermaid swims up behind him.
He thinks it is a fish.

Johnny fixes his raft.
The mermaid asks what he does.
He says he is leaving.
She is heartbroken.

Johnny packs his bags.
The mermaid and shark say bye.
The shark shakes his hand.
Johnny paddles away.

Johnny fans himself in heat.
He fans harder and harder.
He melts into a puddle.

Johnny goes to swim.
He dips a toe in the ocean.
A shark snaps at him.
He scrambles back to shore.

Johnny stands at the edge.
He taps his foot nervously.
Johnny adjusts his pants.

Johnny looks over the ocean.
He adjusts his hat and pants.
Johnny taps his foot.

Johnny lifts his hat
and looks around.

Johnny taps his foot.
He lifts his hat
and looks around.

Johnny taps his foot.
He looks back into
the distance.
Johnny lifts his hat.

Johnny taps his foot.
He looks at the palm tree.
Johnny looks at his raft.
Johnny looks over the ocean.

Johnny looks around
under the palm tree shade.

Johnny pulls out a spyglass
and scans the horizon.

Johnny pulls out a spyglass
and scans the horizon.

A frog clock spins wildly.
A redhead finds the bottle.
She imagines a volcano island
and a handsome man.

A frog clock spins wildly.
Johnny's raft reaches her.
She kisses him passionately,
then scolds him.

Johnny scans with a spyglass.
A plane flies overhead.
He looks the wrong way
and misses it entirely.

A red boat spots Johnny.
He waves excitedly.
The boat is enormous,
it fills the whole screen.

Johnny shakes the palm tree.
A coconut bonks his head
and flies into the ocean.

Johnny shakes the palm tree.
A coconut falls down.
He chases and catches it.
He cracks and eats it.

Johnny shakes the palm tree.
A coconut falls down.
He cracks it on the tree
and eats it.

A boat with partygoers sails up.
Johnny swims to the boat.
He returns very drunk,
wearing a party hat.
Johnny builds up his raft.

Johnny jogs around the island
in a grey jogging outfit.
He changes back to normal.

Johnny finishes building.
He stands at the island edge
and admires his work.

A boat reaches the island.
Johnny climbs aboard
and sails away.

Johnny goes fishing.
He catches a life raft.
He drags it ashore.
